title: Microsoft Purview: eDiscovery- Select user-owned SharePoint embedded container as a data source
description: eDiscovery users will be able to view and select SharePoint Embedded content containers owned or created by a selected person. These containers store content from apps such as Microsoft Loop, Copilot Pages, and Copilot Notebooks.
